# Origin and provenance

- Original package: `rugarch`
- Upstream version: 1.5-6
- Upstream date: 2026-07-18
- Original authors: Alexios Galanos and contributor Tobias Kley
- Original package license: GPL-3
- Uploaded source archive SHA-256: `c624e491c623073f1d81e125953e87e3e573b6851b5a76586cf08025b2c20cdc`
- Fortran translation status: independent, experimental, incomplete
- Translation date: 2026-07-22

The implementation was derived from the computational behavior and source of the
R package. It is not an official release of the upstream maintainer.

Plotting, R object systems, rolling/parallel infrastructure, and bundled datasets
were intentionally omitted. Some advanced algorithms are represented by simpler
standalone numerical implementations and are identified as partial in
`API_MAP.md`.
